record.question: Which of the following statements is correct about the abrogation of Article 370 and 35A by the Constitutional Order of the President of India?
options: The state of Jammu & Kashmir into two Union Territories.
Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2009 come into effect on 31st October 2019.
Ladakh will be administered by Lt. Governor acting on behalf of the Central Government.
This Constitutional Order of the President superseded the Order of 1950.
record.explanation: Jammu and Kashmir was reorganised into two Union Territories.
